subject: Action runway and pilot onramp — Cardinalytics (summary & next steps)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@cardinalytics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-11T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Action runway and pilot onramp — Cardinalytics (summary & next steps)

Alex — thanks again for a productive conversation today. I wanted to capture the decisions and immediate next steps so we have a clean onramp for a short pilot. TL;DR: we think a 4-week pilot, focused on summarization + clinical QA triage, with clear token/latency SLOs, will prove value quickly and unblock an internal eval.

Key pain points you reinforced:
- High time spent by clinical reviewers on low-value triage (~2.5 FTE hours/day)
- Latency spikes when running internal batch reports (affects clinician UX)
- Existing vendor outputs are inconsistent on jargon and patient context handling

Pilot scope proposal (what we discussed):
- Feature set: clinical note summarization (abstractive), triage classifier for priority flags, and a short prompt suite for discharge summary normalization
- Data: 2,500 de-identified notes for evaluation (you to provide S3 path / or share via secured Drive)
- Success metrics: reduction in triage review time (target 30% relative), ROUGE-L / clinical entity preservation, and 95th-percentile inference latency < 600ms for single-token streams under our dedicated config

Owners and roles:
- Cardinalytics: Alex (product lead), Maya (security/compliance), clinical SME TBD
- Redwood: Ben (sales/ops), Vanessa (solutions lead — prompt tuning & evals), Karthik (inference technical lead), Priyom (post-kickoff success manager)

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): access & infra checks, sign off on scope, NDA/PO next steps
- Week 1: ingest + baseline eval; initial prompt set (we'll deliver v1)
- Week 2: tuning pass and daily sync; SLO/latency profiling
- Week 3: user validation with 50 clinical samples; metric collection
- Week 4: readout and decision — go/no-go for wider pilot or production runway

Access and prerequisites we need from Cardinalytics (action items for Maya/Alex):
1) Provision read-only S3 bucket or secure Drive link with de-identified samples (target: 2,500 records)
2) Network checklist: allow outbound to our dedicated endpoint and confirm any IP whitelisting per attached network_infra_checklist.pdf
3) Security questionnaire: we’ll fill a short DSPQ and you’ll confirm SOC2 requirement — placeholder: security@cardinalytics.com
4) Slack channel or MS Teams invite for daily syncs once kickoff is confirmed

Attachments I'm including: MVP_prompt_set_v1.csv (starter prompts and evaluation markers), network_infra_checklist.pdf, and a draft 30-min kickoff calendar (cardinalytics_kickoff_agenda.ics).

Immediate asks from you (please reply):
- Confirm owners and the S3/Drive path we should use for the de-identified notes
- Confirm any procurement or PO steps (finance/Docusign link) we should expect this week
- Best days/times for a project kickoff session (we proposed Tuesday/Thursday mornings)

If that matches your read, I’ll loop Priyom and Vanessa to schedule the Week 0 checklist and create the eval matrix.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0212

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@cardinalytics.com>

Date: 2026-10-12T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action runway and pilot onramp — Cardinalytics (summary & next steps)

Ben — thanks for the clean write-up. Confirmed on scope and owners from our side. Couple quick notes and one security ask below.

We agree with the proposed 4-week window and the metric targets. Priorities from our exec sponsor: demonstrable reviewer time savings (number of cases triaged/day) and no false negatives on priority flags.

Security note (Maya): we need an evidence packet for SOC2 controls around data handling before we move data into any external environment. I can have our security mailbox share a short checklist — they'll want to see encryption-at-rest documentation and a brief on token retention/obs logs. I put security@cardinalytics.com on copy.

Logistics: we can deliver the 2,500 de-identified notes via an S3 bucket (we'll provide a read-only role). Who should I grant the role to? Also procurement: our legal wants a 3-page SOW and a simple PO (we use DocuSign for smaller engagements).

Availability: Tuesday morning (10/14) between 9–11 PT works for Alex + Maya for kickoff.

On the prompts: I skimmed MVP_prompt_set_v1.csv — Vanessa, appreciate if you can call out any questions about entity handling or phrasing that may impact clinical fidelity.

—
Alex Ramos
Product Lead, Integrations | Cardinalytics
alex.ramos@cardinalytics.com

4) Kickoff: locking in Tue 10/14 at 10:00 AM PT for a 45-minute kickoff (we'll include a brief tech check). Calendar invite attached (cardinalytics_kickoff_agenda.ics). If that time changes, flag ASAP.
